        digits_seen = False

            else:

    sep = "e" if "e" in text else ("E" if "E" in text else "")
    mantissa, _, exponent = text.partition(sep) if sep else (text, "", "")

    integer, dot, fraction = mantissa.partition(".")

    body = i + len(start)

            j += 1

    if not sql or sql.isspace():

    length = len(sql)

                result.append(text)
                break
        else:
            char = sql[i]
            result.append(char if char.isspace() else ".")
            i += 1

"""Unit tests for sqlglot.anonymize.anonymize."""

import pytest

from sqlglot.anonymize import anonymize, render
from sqlglot.tokens import Token, TokenType


def texts(tokens):
    return [token.text for token in tokens]


def test_basic_anonymization_replaces_sensitive_tokens_consistently():
    sql = "SELECT customer_id, total FROM orders WHERE amount = 99 AND name = 'Alice'"

    tokens = anonymize(sql)

    assert texts(tokens) == [
        "SELECT",
        "aaaaaaaaaaa",
        ",",
        "aaaab",
        "FROM",
        "aaaaac",
        "WHERE",
        "aaaaad",
        "=",
        "14",
        "AND",
        "aaaf",
        "=",
        "aaaag",
    ]
    # Keywords and punctuation are preserved verbatim.
    assert tokens[0].text == "SELECT"
    assert tokens[4].text == "FROM"
    assert tokens[6].text == "WHERE"
    assert tokens[10].text == "AND"
    # Sensitive tokens keep their original lengths.
    sensitive = {
        1: "customer_id",
        3: "total",
        5: "orders",
        7: "amount",
        9: "99",
        11: "name",
        13: "Alice",
    }
    for index, original in sensitive.items():
        assert len(tokens[index].text) == len(original)
        assert tokens[index].text != original


def test_render_is_length_preserving_and_keeps_quotes():
    sql = 'SELECT "weird col" AS alias, \'secret\' AS s, 42 AS n FROM "my table"'

    tokens = anonymize(sql)
    rendered = render(sql, tokens)

    assert len(rendered) == len(sql)
    assert rendered.startswith('SELECT "aaaaa aaa" AS aaaab')
    assert "'aaaaac'" in rendered
    assert rendered.endswith('FROM "aa aaaag"')
    # The original sensitive values are gone.
    assert "weird col" not in rendered
    assert "secret" not in rendered
    assert "my table" not in rendered


def test_repeated_identifiers_get_same_alias_but_case_matters():
    tokens = anonymize("SELECT name, name, Name FROM users")

    assert texts(tokens) == ["SELECT", "aaaa", ",", "aaaa", ",", "aaab", "FROM", "aac"]
    assert tokens[1].text == tokens[3].text
    assert tokens[1].text != tokens[5].text
    assert len(tokens[5].text) == len("Name")


def test_number_aliases_preserve_shape_and_repeat_by_value():
    tokens = [
        Token(TokenType.NUMBER, "42"),
        Token(TokenType.NUMBER, "42"),
        Token(TokenType.NUMBER, "7"),
        Token(TokenType.NUMBER, "3.14"),
        Token(TokenType.NUMBER, "1.2e-3"),
    ]

    anonymize(tokens)

    assert texts(tokens) == ["10", "10", "2", "1.02", "1.3e-1"]
    # Same input value, same alias.
    assert tokens[0].text == tokens[1].text
    # Shapes are preserved: length, decimal point, exponent marker and sign.
    assert len(tokens[3].text) == len("3.14")
    assert tokens[3].text.index(".") == "3.14".index(".")
    assert len(tokens[4].text) == len("1.2e-3")
    assert tokens[4].text.index("e") == "1.2e-3".index("e")
    assert tokens[4].text[tokens[4].text.index("e") + 1] == "-"

    assert tokens[0].text != tokens[1].text
